description: Machine-readable claim-language rules for static policy and marketing copy under docs/policies/**. LNCH-02 (in-product legal feature) and LNCH-03 (public static site) consume this file and do not invent their own list. These rules do NOT apply to generated answer content — refusal, status and 'no unsupported definitive claim' behaviour is FND-07, EVID-05 and ASSR-04. No rule may be deleted or narrowed to fix a false positive; add an allowed_negations entry instead (LNCH-01 Feedback obligation 2).

rules.rationale: The product may not assert that a customer is, will be or is guaranteed compliant, nor that it ensures compliance.
rules.prd_sentence: It MUST NOT state that a customer is definitely compliant.

rules.rationale: The product is information, evidence-grounded research and conditional guidance, not legal representation, and may not offer or imply legal advice.
rules.prd_sentence: The product provides information, evidence-grounded research and conditional guidance, not legal representation.

rules.rationale: The product may not imply government endorsement of itself or of its reproduction of official material.
rules.prd_sentence: The product MUST NOT reproduce third-party commercial headnotes or imply government endorsement.

rules.rationale: 99.5% is an internal objective, not a contractual service-level agreement, and there is no phone or 24/7 support.
rules.prd_sentence: Availability | 99.5% internal objective; no contractual SLA. Support: No phone or 24/7 support.

rules.rationale: The tested capacity baseline is a system baseline, not a per-customer entitlement or an unlimited-capacity promise.
rules.prd_sentence: This is a tested system baseline, not a single-customer entitlement or unlimited-capacity promise.

rules.rationale: A source category that is not implemented may never be described as covered; coverage limits must stay visible.
rules.prd_sentence: It is not permitted to silently call an unimplemented source category covered.

allowed_negations.why: PRD §11.2 requires the product to say it does NOT state that a customer is definitely compliant. The required denial necessarily contains the phrasing the definite-compliance rule bans.
PRD §11.2 sentence 1 is transcribed verbatim as '... conditional guidance, not legal representation'. The denial contains the banned phrase.

PRD §11.2 sentence 1 ('... conditional guidance, not legal representation') is the basis for the Acceptable Use Policy section title fixed by the LNCH-01 ticket, Deliverable 3, which is literally 'No use as legal representation'.
PRD §13.2 fixes the service position as '99.5% internal objective; no contractual SLA'. Stating the position requires the banned token.
PRD §13.3 fixes the support position as 'No phone or 24/7 support'. Disclosing it requires the banned token.
PRD §13.4 requires the tested baseline to be described as 'not a single-customer entitlement or unlimited-capacity promise'. The denial contains 'unlimited'.
